annotations.title: Create a subdomain for a work

description: Create a new subdomain under a managed domain that shows a work — 'make shop.example.com for my shop'. Only the name before the domain (letters, digits, hyphen). This goes online: ask the user before calling this.

domain_id.description: The managed domain's domain_id from get_address_plan.

name.description: The name before the domain, e.g. shop.

target_kind.description: What should be shown: site, form or shop.

name: create_subdomain
